tips: Track every $1 - small leaks sink ships.
Pay yourself first - save before spending.

chatbot.what is a need: A need is essential for living & studying - like rent, food, transport, course books.
chatbot.what is a want: A want makes life nicer but you can live without it - like new video game, restaurant food.
chatbot.what is a budget: A budget is a plan for your money: Income - Expenses = Savings. It helps you control spending.
chatbot.how much should i save: Try 20% of income if possible. Even $10/week builds habit. 50/30/20 is a guideline.
chatbot.how do i avoid overspending: Track expenses, use Pause Before Buying, set limits for wants, remove saved cards from shopping sites.
chatbot.what is an expense: Expense is money you spend - fixed (rent) or variable (snacks).
chatbot.fallback: I'm BudgetBee! I only know basic budgeting topics: needs, wants, budget, saving, expenses. Try asking about those.

mistakes.title: Impulse Buying
mistakes.scenario: Seeing a sale and buying instantly.
mistakes.fix: Use 24-hour rule. Add to wishlist, revisit tomorrow.

mistakes.title: Ignoring Small Expenses
mistakes.fix: Track every expense for 7 days in planner.

mistakes.title: Late Payments
mistakes.scenario: Paying library fine or phone bill late.
mistakes.explain: Fees waste money and cause stress.
mistakes.fix: Set phone reminders 2 days before due.

mistakes.title: Unused Subscriptions
